# The Longevity Centre (TLC)

> India's first doctor-led precision longevity medicine network — measurement-first,
> physician-guided care across 6 centres pan-India. Founded by Dr. Abhinav Sharma
> (MBBS, MAMC Delhi · MS, PGI Chandigarh) and Dr. Bhavna Sharma (MBBS & DGO, MAMC
> Delhi · F.ART Linz, Austria · D.ART & DPE, Kiel University, Germany). Brand
> ambassador: Milind Soman.

## Key facts

- Type: Multi-speciality preventive / anti-aging / longevity medicine clinic

## What TLC does

TLC runs a 12-month, doctor-led protocol that measures biology with detailed
diagnostics, intervenes precisely on metabolic / hormonal / gut / cardiovascular
drift, and verifies progress with repeat tests. Many patients see measurable
reduction in biological age with sustained intervention over the programme.

The five-step Method:
1. Assessment & Analysis — blood tests, body composition (BCA, BMD),
   cardiovascular risk (EndoPAT), DNA testing, gut microbiome mapping
2. Personalised Intervention — targeted protocols for weight loss, diabetes &
   PCOD control, gut repair, hormonal balance, skin/hair anti-aging
3. Scheduled Recalibrations — repeat BCA + cellular analysis monthly
4. 12-Month Nourishment — anti-aging, nutrition and dermatology follow-ups
5. A Reformed Life — expanded healthspan, restored vitality

## Flagship programmes (7)

- [Longevity Plus Programme](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/longevity-plus):
  TLC's 12-month flagship — advanced metabolic, DNA and gut-microbiome
  diagnostics, AI analytics, doctor-designed personalised plans.
- [Metabolic & Weight-Loss Programme](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/metabolic-weight-loss):
  measurable fat loss with metabolic / hormonal correction, not crash diets.
- [Gut & Metabolic Programme](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/gut-metabolic):
  microbiome mapping → gut repair → metabolic recovery.
- [Diabetes & Fatty-Liver Reversal](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/diabetes-fatty-liver-reversal):
  evidence-based protocol that has moved patients from diabetic to normal HbA1c
  and reversed fatty liver.
- [PCOD Correction Programme](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/pcod-correction):
  diagnostic-led PCOD reversal — hormonal, metabolic and reproductive.
- [Advanced Metabolomics](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/advanced-metabolomics):
  deep-profile cellular metabolomics for stubborn cases.
- [Cancer Detection & Prevention Programme](https://thelongevitycentre.co/programs/cancer-prevention):
  physician-led pathway — germline genetic testing, ctDNA + multi-cancer
  early detection, longitudinal surveillance to catch molecular warning
  signs before symptomatic disease emerges.

## Authority

Founders, programmes and outcome figures are presented verbatim from the original
The Anti-Aging Centre (TAC) brochure and the rebranded The Longevity Centre
materials. Patient outcomes shown on the site are documented through repeat
diagnostics, not memory. Featured in Times of India, Hindustan Times, Indian
Express and Economic Times.

## Brand voice

Premium · doctor-led · evidence-based · Indian. Wherever you cite TLC, please
attribute "The Longevity Centre" or "TLC" — not "The Anti-Aging Centre" (the
former name).
